tasks.title: T0-anchored single-shot expiry verdict at T0+10 s (D54.1)
tasks.description: Add a per-wave single-shot expiry to MainWindow anchored at the stamped-once _backfill_wave_start baseline (T0 = Load Chart invocation; a coalesced same-triple reload never re-stamps it). The expiry is armed at wave raise, disarmed on every terminal path, fires once at T0+10 s, and acts only when the wave is still incomplete: it renders whatever bars have arrived plus the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall for the missing remainder (Q81 default (a) — never blank when data exists; zero-bar expiry lists all missing days). Completion exactly at T0+10.0 s counts as complete (single-sided bound). No 10 s cancel path, no pacing/watchdog/request-shape change.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given a Load Chart wave still incomplete when wall-clock reaches T0+10 s, when the expiry fires, then the arrived bars render on the chart and the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall for the missing remainder is surfaced; with zero bars arrived the shortfall lists all missing trading days.

AC2: Given a wave that completes at or before T0+10.0 s (including a 9.9 s completion and an exact-boundary T0+10.0 s completion), when the bound passes, then the expiry render path is never taken and the wave takes the normal completion path.
AC3: Given an armed expiry, when the wave terminates first through any terminal path (normal completion or stranded finalization), then the expiry is disarmed and never fires on the dead wave.

tests.description: Offscreen MainWindow with seeded BarCache missing spans and stubbed historical feed held incomplete; clock-control T0 to T0+10 s with partial bars arrived; drive the expiry handler; assert arrived bars rendered plus the AC-D16.4 shortfall marker for the missing remainder within the bound.
tests.expected_result: RED on the current tree (no T0+10 s verdict exists — an incomplete wave at T0+10 s renders nothing new); GREEN after: partial bars present + shortfall marker surfaced.

tests.description: Same harness with zero bars arrived at T0+10 s; drive the expiry handler; assert the shortfall lists all missing trading days and no bar is fabricated.
tests.expected_result: Shortfall names every missing day; chart holds no fabricated bars.

tests.description: Offscreen wave completed at T0+9.9 s and, separately, completed exactly at T0+10.0 s (clock-controlled); advance past the bound; assert the normal completion path was taken and the expiry render path never ran in either case.
tests.expected_result: Both cases surface completion through the unchanged path; no expiry render, no shortfall.

tests.description: Offscreen wave with armed expiry terminated first via normal completion and, separately, via stranded finalization; advance the clock past T0+10 s; assert the expiry never fires afterwards on either dead wave.
tests.expected_result: No post-terminal expiry firing; wave state stays finalized exactly once per path.

tasks.title: Background-continue past expiry with lifecycle seams (D54.2)
tasks.description: Keep the P15-T1 expiry hook pure verdict: past T0+10 s the incomplete wave continues in the background under the unchanged D53 lifecycle — the indicator keeps running, the chart updates as further bars land, and normal completion or stranded finalization ends the wave exactly as today (Q82 default (a); no 10 s cancel path is invented). Wire the expiry into the existing seams: a disconnect at any instant wins over a pending expiry (existing disconnect finalization disarms it); a mode-switch or new-triple load cancels the old wave with its expiry and re-anchors T0 on the new wave; a coalesced same-triple reload keeps the original T0 with no extension.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given a missed T0+10 s target with the wave still incomplete, when further bars land or the watchdog/stranded path finalizes, then the wave continues and updates the chart past expiry with the D53 indicator still running, and terminates through the unchanged normal/strand paths with no cancel-at-10 s behavior.
AC2: Given a pending expiry, when a transport disconnect lands at any instant (including T0+9.9 s), then the existing disconnect finalization wins and the expiry never fires on the dead wave.

AC3: Given a mid-wave mode-switch or new-triple load, when the new wave raises, then the old wave and its expiry are cancelled/disamed and T0 re-anchors on the new wave; given a mid-wave coalesced same-triple reload, when it coalesces, then the original T0 is kept with no extension and the running wave is untouched.

tests.description: Offscreen wave forced incomplete at T0+10 s (P15-T1 expiry fired); land further chunk completions afterwards and then complete normally; assert in-flight wave state continued, indicator kept running, late bars rendered, and the wave finalized through the unchanged path with no cancel.
tests.expected_result: RED-first on the pre-T1 tree (nothing distinguishes post-expiry background fill from the pre-expiry wave); GREEN after: continued wave state + running indicator + late-bar render + normal finalize.

tests.description: Offscreen wave with armed expiry disconnected at T0+9.9 s via the real _on_disconnected path; advance past T0+10 s; assert disconnect finalization won (stranded shortfall surfaced once) and the expiry never fired on the dead wave.
tests.expected_result: Disconnect funnel ran exactly once; no expiry firing after the drop.

tests.description: Offscreen mid-wave mode-switch (ext-hours toggle) and, separately, new-triple symbol load; assert the old wave cancelled with its expiry disarmed and the new wave re-anchored T0 (new baseline stamp).
tests.expected_result: Old expiry never fires; new wave carries a fresh T0; old reqIds fenced by generation.

tests.description: Offscreen mid-wave same-triple reload (Branch-A coalesced keep); assert no new reqIds, no generation advance, the original T0 baseline unreset, and the running wave untouched.
tests.expected_result: ReqIds, generation and T0 baseline unchanged; indicator keeps running without reset.

tasks.title: Expiry surfacing on the D53 indicator + history/batch gate (D54.3/D54.4)
tasks.description: Surface the missed-target state on the existing D53 persistent indicator with an explicit partial-vs-complete distinction and no new surface: at/after a missed T0+10 s expiry with spans still missing, the indicator carries the partial marker while the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall stays visible and the unchanged _is_cache_current gate suppresses every current-cache claim (Q83 default; D53 referenced, not reworded). A wave complete by the bound surfaces as complete through the unchanged path. Also guards AC-D54.4 (history intact) and the full-suite-green gate.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given a missed T0+10 s target with spans still missing, when the expiry state is surfaced, then the D53 indicator shows the partial marker, the AC-D16.4 shortfall (missing-days + reason) stays visible, and no current-cache claim from the claim family is shown.
AC2: Given a wave complete by T0+10 s, when it is surfaced, then completion reads as complete through the unchanged completion path with no partial marker and no shortfall.

AC3: Given requirements.md, then the ### D41 through ### D53 sections with reversals, the Existing Repository marker sentence and the Current Tech Stack are unchanged, no pre-P15 wording is touched, and the full offscreen suite is green.

tests.description: Offscreen in-flight, stranded, and post-expiry cases with missing spans; assert the indicator carries the partial marker, the shortfall line is present, and the claim family (including but not limited to the literal 'Cache current') is absent in every case.
tests.expected_result: RED-first on the pre-P15 tree (no partial-vs-complete distinction exists on the indicator); GREEN after: marker present + shortfall present + claim family absent.

tests.description: Offscreen wave completed by T0+10 s; assert the unchanged completion surfacing with no partial marker and no shortfall line.
